label: Punctuation inside numeric strings
explanation: Fires on punctuation embedded in numbers and codes — decimals, citation colons, hyphens in IDs/phone numbers, thousands commas, currency symbols — strongest when digit-flanked; ordinary prose punctuation rarely fires.
